experiments.scope: The exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target on the instance the harness hashes: one chunk, counter 0, flags 11. Per organizer seed one trial runs the search of proof.md 18.3 on 256 batches (1,792 proposals) drawn from the seed: the winner member and the five-bit slot (18.1), step CO on packed lanes, the exact filter of the fourteen outcomes, and for each passing proposal the 32-slot sampler of 18.7 (one row and one leaf path with (P*), (G7) and (G15)) and the certificate of step 3 (18.14). The pair is built by step CT on the first passing proposal (the first proposal if none passes) with the c1 that makes t = 0. No BLAKE3 library is imported; SHAKE-256 only expands the seed.
experiments.hypothesis: Every trial's two complete digests agree on words 0, 2, 5 and 7 (the 128 masked bits): exact by proof.md 6.4. The 14 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted: outer_steps, passes, solver_steps, slot_rows (slots that name a row of the mask), solver_units and solver_units_max (path ledger against the cap 5,864 of 18.7), over_cap, units, roots, roots_t0, certified, verify_fail, halted, pair_step. Expected per trial: about 9.7 passes (pi14 = 2^-7.532), about 78 units per proposal by the program's ledger, almost always 0 roots. It does not measure the rate. In the participant's run of 256 seeds: 10.03 passes and 1.39 slot rows per trial, solver_units_max at most 5,257, no root.

experiments.scope: As half-collision (the same trial, counts and proposal), then, keeping the seven outer words of that proposal, the members of the winner sub-class in order from its member, each at most once (65,536), each giving a pair by steps CO and CT with t = 0, until the residual has a zero low byte in digest word 1. tries and member_units (1,002 per try, computed as tries times that charge, proof.md 18.14) are added to the observations; failed trials return null pairs.
experiments.hypothesis: Every returned pair agrees on 136 digest bits: the 128 of the half-collision and the low byte of digest word 1. The members are tried in order and are not independent, so tries is not a measured rate; in the participant's run of 256 seeds the mean was 362.9 (3 to 2,283), and no seed failed. It tests no heuristic and shows no attack cost.
